rv.q: Lazy Susan Theatre Co.’s production of Our Town is a lovely reminder of why Thornton Wilder’s play has remained a theatrical classic for generations.
The brilliant Matthew Masino (Director) breathes new life into this classic work that Edward Albee once wrote is ‘the best American play ever written.’
The crew at TAPS clearly understood the assignment.
Lazy Susan’s production serves as a reminder of the simple potency of Wilder’s world.

Lazy Susan’s version “t’aint perfect,” as the folks onstage would say, but it is engaging and moving and very much worth seeing, especially if you’ve never experienced it before, or only by way of a long-ago high school production.
Lazy Susan Theatre is staging a warm and naturalistic production laden with the sweetness and sorrows of daily life.
It turned out to be a quiet, gentle show that sneaks up on you in the final act.

With a welcoming preshow, an engaging ensemble, and an intimate staging that makes the audience feel a part of the community, Lazy Susan Co.'s Our Town is a heartfelt celebration of life's everyday moments.
Bring some tissues as you will find the need to wipe some tears away.

cn.t: Critics widely praise Lazy Susan Theatre Co.'s *Our Town* for its warm, intimate staging and engaging ensemble that breathes fresh life into Wilder's classic. A heartfelt, moving production that resonates deeply.
